Hi Michael,

For reference, the Harlo H15 Dual on that order ships November 14, 2026, with the Power Kit going out in the same box. You can follow incoming batches at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status, and tracking comes to this address as soon as the label is printed.

Great, I was hoping everything would ship in one box instead of multiple
shipments.

I look forward to seeing it ship out on Nov 14th!

Hi Michael,

My pleasure, and thanks for catching the postcode ····.

Yes, it goes out as one parcel: the Harlo H15 Dual and the Power Kit ship together, and the Harlo OS Diagnostics plus 3-Month RMA on the order is a service on the unit, so there is nothing separate to send for it. Ship date stays November 14, and the tracking number comes to this address as soon as the label is printed.

If anything changes on the address or you want to add something to the box before it goes, just reply here and I will sort it.

If you are not in our community yet, you are welcome in the Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, for setup help and new products.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
